run_mocap_demo: run the mocap demo with a CMU .amc motion capture file to visualize humanoid movement
parse_amc_convert: parse an AMC motion capture file and convert it to MuJoCo qpos format for the humanoid environment
render_humanoid_frames: render the humanoid_CMU environment from two camera angles and stack frames into a video array
playback_mocap_video: playback parsed motion capture frames in real-time using matplotlib with adjustable frame limits
review_main: review the main function that parses AMC files, renders frames, and plays back mocap data
